title: Plenty of good memories, lessons for Tokong after WSL exit
summary: Veteran Filipino surfer John Mark "Marama" Tokong is not dwelling on lost opportunities even as he lamented his early exit from the World Surf League (WSL) Championship Tour Philippines Pro.
